system.description:
Prerequisites: Basic Protean, Intermediate Vicissitude. Some Tzimisce combine the Protean power to turn into an animal with the possibilities of Vicissitude, forcing chaotic change to surge through the Fiend's body while he directs it through bone-breaking pain. When the strain becomes too much to bear, the body settles into the Pater Szlachta or bogatyri form — named by Tzimisce anarchs to insult either their servants or the "elder valiant champions" who served their sires. In the modern nights this power is known to a few Tzimisce, who sometimes use it in contests of improvisational fleshcrafting.

System: Spend two blood points and roll Stamina + Medicine (difficulty 7). The change takes (5 minus the number of successes) turns to complete, during which the Tzimisce can only howl, drool vitae, and writhe. The character can rearrange his Physical Attributes (one dot per success), though no Attribute may exceed the limit imposed by generation; the player describes the alterations desired, but the Storyteller is the final arbiter of the resulting form (bone spikes, spine-saws, reinforced hide, and the like). Botches earn whatever physical Flaws the Storyteller chooses, possibly permanent ones. The change lasts one scene. Costs 18 experience points to learn.

MET System: Your body increases its mass for every Blood Trait you spend. First enter a Static Physical Challenge against the Storyteller; if successful, you increase your Physical Trait category by two Traits for every Blood Trait consumed this way, possibly exceeding the limits of your Generation.
system.source: Clanbook: Tzimisce, Chapter Two: Ego and Evolution
system.bloodCost: Two blood points (System) / one per two Physical Traits gained (MET)
